description: Nova Skills Canonical Financing, Payment Plans & EMI Options Registry
disclaimer: Financing and EMI availability depends on payment aggregator partnerships, issuing bank eligibility, and third-party credit evaluation. Nova Skills maintains complete cost transparency: unverified financing rates are never advertised as guaranteed.

tier1ShortCourses.statement: Paid as a single lump-sum enrollment fee. Multi-month bank financing is not applicable due to banking partner transaction minimums.

tier2MediumPrograms.statement: Eligible for 2-stage institutional installment plans or standard bank credit card EMI subject to cardholder credit limits.

tier3MasteryPrograms.statement: Eligible for multi-stage milestone payment plans and bank EMI options (3, 6, 9, or 12 months) through authorized payment partners.

financingModels.description: Third-party financing arrangement where the student pays zero net interest because the institute absorbs the interest charge as an upfront discount (merchant subvention).
financingModels.processingFees: Bank processing fees (₹199–₹299 + GST) may be charged directly by the issuing bank

financingModels.description: Convenience installment option provided directly by the student's credit card issuing bank at prevailing commercial rates.

eligibleInstruments: All Major Indian Bank Credit Cards

financingModels.interestRate: 13% to 16% per annum (charged by issuing bank)

financingModels.description: Direct institutional payment schedule dividing course tuition into 2 or 3 scheduled milestone payments without a third-party loan.
